name: com.adivery.data.location.LocationJobService
description: Adivery ad SDK runs this background job when Android starts it and the app has location permission. It reads the last known GPS or network location, or a saved location, then sends the coordinates, accuracy, altitude, and advertising ID to Adivery’s audience service.
disableEffect: Adivery will no longer receive location audience data through this component; the app’s own features continue to work.
